summary: Inventory lists managed hosts, their variables and groups, from one or more sources. The default is /etc/ansible/hosts; use -i or config for others, and options include dynamic inventory, multiple sources and inventory directories.
questions: Where is Ansible's default inventory file?
How do I use a different inventory file?
Can I use more than one inventory source?

answer_card.title: Inventory basics and default location
answer_card.answer_md:
Inventory defines the hosts you automate, their variables and groups. The default file is `/etc/ansible/hosts`. Use `-i <path or expression>` or the config to use others.

As it grows you can generate inventory dynamically with plugins, combine multiple sources (static and dynamic), or use a directory of sources.
